message.content:
I see a potential issue in `remove_vc_all_except`. It uses `FLAC__metadata_object_vorbiscomment_delete_comment(block, i)` which deletes a comment and may reallocate the `comments` array. But the loop iterates over `block->data.vorbis_comment.comments[i]` and `block->data.vorbis_comment.num_comments`. When a comment is deleted, the array is reallocated (shrunk), and the pointer `block->data.vorbis_comment.comments` may be freed and reallocated. But the loop uses `block->data.vorbis_comment.comments[i]` which should be fine since it re-reads the pointer each time.
